definition: Recurring arrangement of products, capabilities and mechanisms.
Typed operation offered under a semantic contract.
Stateful or policy component inside a product boundary.
Observed implementation or provider; unqualified until conformance evidence exists.

Commercial or administrative packaging of products; owns no merged semantics.
